title: How do I get started as a State Citizen ( National ) & separating the Strawman lawfully in the USA!
summary: Promoter explains state-citizen status and separating from the all-caps strawman through name styling, UCC 1-308, UCC-1 filings and nonresident tax forms.

verdicts.note: Capitalization and punctuation of a name have no legal effect; courts reject the argument outright.
Name forms like '::Dennis-Larry: Meads::' and 'i: a man' are described as characteristic but meaningless indicia of OPCA litigants.
Litigants styled as 'scott-william of the house of Larsen' or 'S-I-R-Crown' were unsuccessful; the legal name still identified them.
